entities.summary: Bradley Austin Chubb is an American professional football linebacker for the Buffalo Bills of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the NC State Wolfpack, and was selected by the Denver Broncos in the first round of the 2018 NFL draft. Chubb was traded to the Miami Dolphins in 2022, and played for them until he was released in 2026.
